name: Ollie WhatsApp Cloud API Channel
description: Inbound WhatsApp via the official Meta Cloud API (Graph v21.0). Registers /plugins/whatsapp-cloud/webhook on the gateway loopback HTTP server, handles the Meta verification handshake, validates X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC, dedupes by message id, and (when enabled + secrets present) routes inbound text messages into Ollie as channel-id 'whatsapp-cloud' so the existing ollie-wa-approval before_agent_run gate fires. Outbound replies are sent via Graph API directly (no native channel adapter).

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the plugin loads but the route handlers are no-ops (still return 200 fast so Meta does not retry). Flip to true after the secret file is in place and the gateway has been reloaded.

secretFile.description: Path to the JSON file holding phoneNumberId, wabaId, accessToken, appSecret, verifyToken. Mode 600. Tilde is expanded at runtime.

dedupeFile.description: Persistent Set of message ids we have already processed. Atomic-rename writes. Tilde is expanded at runtime.

logEveryInbound.description: If true, log a one-line summary of every accepted inbound event at info level. If false, only log errors and dedupe hits.

enabled.label: Channel enabled
enabled.help: When false, the webhook route still mounts so the gateway boots cleanly, but the handler is a no-op that returns 200 quickly. Use this to stage the deploy before pointing ngrok/Meta at the box.

secretFile.label: Secret file
secretFile.help: JSON file with {phoneNumberId, wabaId, accessToken, appSecret, verifyToken}. Must exist and be readable by the gateway user; mode 600 recommended.

dedupeFile.label: Dedupe state file
dedupeFile.description: JSON file holding a Set of seen messages[].id values. Survives gateway restarts. The plugin trims the set to the most recent 5000 ids on each write.

logEveryInbound.label: Log every inbound
logEveryInbound.help: If false, only log errors. The default is true to make go-live debugging easier.
